Cristiano Ronaldo handed his man of the match trophy to teammate Abdullah Al-Hamdan after Al-Nassr defeated Al-Faisaly 3-1 in the Saudi Pro League on Friday. As reported by Sabah Spor, a Turkish sports news outlet on Friday, Ronaldo was named man of the match following his performance in the encounter but chose to give the award to Al-Hamdan in recognition of his contribution to the victory. The match, played at Al-Majma’ah Sports City Stadium, saw Al-Nassr take an early lead through Al-Hamdan, who opened the scoring in the fourth minute. Ronaldo doubled the advantage in the 49th minute, rising to head home a free-kick delivery from João Félix. The goal was reported to be the 982nd of his career. Al-Hamdan later turned provider, setting up Ângelo to score Al-Nassr’s third goal in the 79th minute and help seal the victory. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources Despite receiving the official man-of-the-match award, Ronaldo called Al-Hamdan over at full-time and handed him the trophy before posing for photographs with his teammate. The gesture attracted attention from supporters, with many praising the Portuguese captain for recognising Al-Hamdan’s contribution of a goal and an assist. The victory moved Al-Nassr temporarily to the top of the Saudi Pro League table with 25 points, strengthening their position in the title race.
